adcp_version.description: Release-precision AdCP version (VERSION.RELEASE, e.g. "3.0", "3.1", "3.1-beta"). On a request: the buyer's release pin — the seller validates against its supported_versions and returns VERSION_UNSUPPORTED on cross-major mismatch, or downshifts to the highest supported release within the same major. On a response: the release the seller actually served — clients SHOULD validate the response against that release's schema, not against their pin. Patches are not negotiated; surface them as build_version on capabilities for operational visibility. When omitted, falls back to adcp_major_version (deprecated) or server default. Buyers SHOULD emit both adcp_version and adcp_major_version through 3.x to remain compatible with sellers that only read the legacy field. NORMALIZATION: SDKs that read full-semver values from bundle metadata (e.g. ComplianceIndex.published_version = "3.1.0-beta.1") MUST normalize to release-precision ("3.1-beta.1") before emitting on the wire — meta-field values are NOT valid wire values.

adcp_major_version.description: DEPRECATED in favor of adcp_version (release-precision string). Servers MUST continue to honor this field through 3.x. Removed in 4.0. Original semantics: the AdCP major version the buyer's payloads conform to. Sellers validate against their supported major_versions and return VERSION_UNSUPPORTED if unsupported. When omitted, the seller assumes its highest supported version.

message.description: Natural language instructions for the transformation or generation. For pure generation, this is the creative brief. For transformation, this provides guidance on how to adapt the creative. For refinement, this describes the desired changes.

creative_manifest.description: Creative manifest to transform or generate from. On the canonical 3.2 path it carries `format_kind`, optional `format_option_ref`, and the required input assets. For transformation (for example resizing or reformatting), this is the complete creative to adapt. When creative_id is provided, the agent resolves the creative from its library and this field is ignored.

creative_representation_set.description: Complete creative revision containing equivalent trafficking representations, of which exactly one is selected for this seller-bound output. This mode is accepted only by the destination sales agent and requires representation_destination plus representation_selection_strategy. The target capability selects the seller's build route; representation_destination supplies the binding inventory contract. The resolver verifies revision_content_digest against the complete set, retains every representation unchanged, selects exactly one compatible representation, and returns a manifest carrying representation_selection. If macro_values is present, selection happens first and binding affects only the derived output; the retained representation set and its revision binding never change. When none is compatible, the request fails with CREATIVE_REPRESENTATION_UNRESOLVED and one representation_rejections entry per candidate.

representation_destination.description: Seller-owned product and effective format context for representation resolution. Required only with creative_representation_set and meaningful only when this endpoint is the destination sales agent.

representation_selection_strategy.description: Deterministic strategy to apply after compatibility filtering. Required with creative_representation_set and MUST be advertised by creative.representation_resolution.strategies.

creative_id.description: Reference to a creative in the agent's library. The creative agent resolves this to a manifest from its library. Use this instead of creative_manifest when retrieving an existing creative for tag generation or format adaptation.

concept_id.description: Creative concept containing the creative. Creative agents SHOULD assign globally unique creative_id values; when they cannot guarantee uniqueness, concept_id is REQUIRED to disambiguate.

media_buy_id.description: Media buy identifier for tag generation context. When the creative agent is also the ad server, this provides the trafficking context needed to generate placement-specific tags (e.g., CM360 placement ID). Not needed when tags are generated at the creative level (most creative platforms).

package_id.description: Package identifier within the media buy. Used with media_buy_id when the creative agent needs line-item-level context for tag generation. Omit to get a tag not scoped to a specific package.

target_format_id.description: **DEPRECATED in 3.2.** Legacy named-format selector. Use `target_capability_id` with a value advertised in `get_adcp_capabilities.creative.supported_formats[].capability_id`.

target_format_ids.description: **DEPRECATED in 3.2.** Legacy named-format selectors. Use `target_capability_ids` with values advertised in `get_adcp_capabilities.creative.supported_formats[].capability_id`.

target_capability_id.description: Canonical 3.2 single-output selector. Matches exactly one `get_adcp_capabilities.creative.supported_formats[].capability_id` advertised by this creative agent. The matched entry supplies the canonical `format` declaration used to validate inputs and the returned manifest. Mutually exclusive with `target_capability_ids` and the deprecated target_format_id fields.

target_capability_ids.description: Canonical 3.2 multi-output selector. Each value matches a `get_adcp_capabilities.creative.supported_formats[].capability_id`. The creative agent produces one canonical manifest per capability in request order. Mutually exclusive with `target_capability_id` and the deprecated target_format_id fields.

transformer_id.description: Selects an account-scoped transformer (discovered via list_transformers) to perform the build. One transformer per call. When present, the build uses this transformer and target_capability_id/target_capability_ids select which of its outputs to produce — they MUST be a subset of the transformer's output_capability_ids. Deprecated target_format_id fields use the legacy output_format_ids compatibility path. Render configuration goes in `config`.

config.description: Typed render configuration for the selected transformer, keyed by each param's `field` (from the transformer's params[] in list_transformers). Example: { "voice": "isaac", "speaking_rate": 1.1, "mastering_preset": "podcast" }. The agent MUST validate `config` against the transformer's live params for this account and reject unrecognized keys and out-of-range / non-enumerated values with a field-attributed error (e.g. `config.voice`) rather than silently ignoring them — config drives a paid render. Genuinely vendor-specific or experimental knobs not declared as params belong in `ext`, not here. (The schema leaves this object open because legal keys are dynamic per transformer; strict validation is a normative agent obligation.) When `refine_from_build_variant_id` is set, `config` is applied as a DELTA over the parent leaf's config.

refine_from_build_variant_id.description: Refine a previously produced variant and return new lineage-linked variants. The transformer and target capability are inherited from the parent leaf. A refinement request MUST omit transformer_id, target_capability_id(s), and deprecated target_format_id(s); changing transformer or output format is a new transformation build, not refinement. Requires creative.supports_refinement.

mode.description: `execute` (default) produces and bills the creative(s). `estimate` is a DRY RUN: the agent produces nothing and bills nothing, and returns a BuildCreativeEstimate with a projected cost band (cost_low/cost_high) computed against THIS request's actual inputs (script length, brief, catalog size, max_creatives × max_variants) — the band the buyer cannot derive itself, since per_unit gives the rate but not the unit count. Requires the agent to advertise `creative.supports_spend_controls`; otherwise rejected with `UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE`.

max_spend.description: Hard per-call spend ceiling. The agent produces leaves until the NEXT leaf would push the run's aggregate vendor_cost over `amount`, then STOPS and returns the partial BuildCreativeVariantSuccess produced so far with `budget_status: "capped"` (every returned leaf is real, trafficable, and billed — nothing produced is discarded; the leaf shortfall is `leaves_returned` < `leaves_total`). If even the first leaf would exceed the cap, the call fails with BUDGET_CAP_REACHED. `currency` MUST match the rate card's currency (the agent does not FX-convert) or the request is rejected with INVALID_REQUEST (error.field `max_spend.currency`). Requires `creative.supports_spend_controls`. Caps a SINGLE call — to bound a refinement loop, track aggregate vendor_cost across calls and stop issuing them (buyer responsibility in this revision). max_spend bounds only build-time vendor_cost: CPM-priced builds (estimate basis `cpm_deferred`) have build-time vendor_cost 0 and accrue at serve time, so max_spend never engages for them — bound a CPM fan-out with max_creatives instead.

max_creatives.description: Caps how many DISTINCT creatives to produce along the catalog/item fan-out axis — one creative per catalog item. Use it to sample a large catalog (e.g. send 150 job openings, set max_creatives: 5 to preview five). Distinct from item_limit, which caps how many catalog items a SINGLE creative consumes (DCO-style). Omitted with a catalog input means one creative per item up to the catalog/format bound; omitted without a catalog collapses to a single creative. Large fan-outs may return asynchronously. Mutually exclusive with `refine_from_build_variant_id` (refinement targets one prior creative, not a catalog fan-out). Supported only when the agent advertises `creative.multiplicity.supports_catalog_fanout`; values above `max_creatives_limit` are clamped. Pair with `max_spend` to bound the bill of a large fan-out.

signal_conditions.description: Advisory keep-all PRODUCTION axis: produce one distinct creative group per signal condition, each kept and trafficked with its own signal targeting (e.g. a rain creative AND a sun creative). Sibling to max_creatives (catalog axis), NOT a variant_axis value (which is choose-among). Each item reuses SignalTargeting (value_type-discriminated binary/categorical/numeric over signal_ref) so the produced group's signal_condition resolves condition identity through the SAME schema the sales-side package targeting uses, plus an optional signal_agent_segment_id carrying the RESOLVED-segment identity (vs signal_ref's definition identity) — echo a provider-exposed handle verbatim; it is the primary trafficking-compatibility key, with categorical signal_ref+value as the weaker fallback. Per #5280 this is an ADVISORY context pointer — it informs production and MUST NOT hard-block at the build_creative layer; trafficking-compatibility (a sun creative MUST NOT serve into rain-targeted packages) is enforced reject-at-trafficking on the sales side (SIGNAL_TARGETING_INCOMPATIBLE), not here. Triggers the BuildCreativeVariantSuccess shape. Supported only when the agent advertises creative.multiplicity.supports_signal_fanout; condition counts above max_signal_conditions_limit are CLAMPED (not rejected), consistent with max_creatives. Composes with max_creatives (catalog × conditions cross-product) and max_variants (variants per group).

max_variants.description: Caps how many ALTERNATIVES to produce per creative (different voices, themes, best-of-N, etc.). Default 1 preserves single-output behavior. Each variant is a real, independently-billed build (you pay for all produced); the buyer keeps one or many. When variant_axis.values[] is provided, its length is authoritative over max_variants. Resolutions/quality tiers are NOT variants — request them as additional target formats.

variant_axis.description: Declares the dimension along which variants differ. When `values` is provided, the agent produces exactly one variant per value (e.g. an A/B of two voices). When only `dimension` is provided, the agent chooses up to max_variants variants along that dimension (e.g. best-of-N, themes).

keep_mode.description: Advisory hint for how the buyer intends to use the variants. `keep_one` (best-of-N) and `keep_some` signal the agent to set `recommended`/`rank` on returned variants. Advisory only — it does not change what is returned or billed; every produced variant is returned and charged. Keeping is a client act of trafficking the chosen build_variant_id(s).

selection_strategy.description: Governs HOW the agent samples when max_creatives < items_total (folds #5262). audience_relevance draws its ranking input from the SAME signal_ref pointers in signal_conditions / package targeting — NOT a parallel signals[] array. proximity takes a location input (geo shape TBD — WG open). inventory_priority is seller-side catalog metadata (margin/overstock/promo; no buyer input). random is the status-quo default. Per-creative selection ordering surfaces on the existing rank / recommended fields of creatives[].variants[], not a new selection_rank. Advisory; absent => agent default (random).

brand.description: Brand reference for creative generation. Resolved to full brand identity (colors, logos, tone) at execution time.

quality.description: Quality tier for generation. 'draft' produces fast, lower-fidelity output for iteration and review. 'production' produces full-quality output for final delivery. If omitted, the creative agent uses its own default. For non-generative transforms (e.g., format resizing), creative agents MAY ignore this field.

evaluator.description: Optional advisory evaluator (buyer-attached pointer, #5280) declaring how produced variants should be evaluated and ranked — the rank-side of the get_creative_features feature oracle. Experimental (x-status: experimental): the whole evaluator surface is new and unfrozen, and requires creative.supports_evaluator, which sellers MUST pair with `creative.evaluator` in experimental_features. Drives the producing agent's gate-then-rank pipeline over its best_of_n exploration: per leaf, evaluate (the chosen form) → optionally GATE (`evaluator.feature_requirement[]`, drop fails — internal pruning of which leaves the agent recommends, never an AdCP-layer block of an already-produced billable leaf) → RANK survivors (`evaluator.rank_by`, an explicit {feature_id, direction} ordering). Feature discovery uses get_adcp_capabilities governance.creative_features for rank_by, feature_requirement, and eval.features[]; evaluator_id is a pre-provisioned/account-arranged preset, not an ID discovered from that catalog. Populates a per-leaf `eval` block of creative-feature values (creative-feature-result[]) when supports_evaluator. When the evaluator names an external agent (`evaluator.feature_agent.agent_url` or the agent-form `agent_url`), that agent MUST appear in the seller's `creative_policy.accepted_verifiers[]` (the same allowlist #5280 established for provenance verify_agent); an off-list agent is rejected with `EVALUATOR_AGENT_NOT_ACCEPTED`. The outbound evaluator call authenticates on the transport (request signing/JWKS, mTLS, or a pre-provisioned static credential); credentials and caller-supplied trust material MUST NOT appear in evaluator, context, ext, or creative payload fields, and credential- or trust-material keys should be rejected with `CREDENTIAL_IN_ARGS`. With no `feature_requirement`, evaluation is advisory only and does not change what is produced or billed; an unreachable/unknown on-list agent degrades to seller-default ranking (advisory errors[] note), not a failure. Requires creative.supports_evaluator; otherwise ignored.

item_limit.description: Maximum number of catalog items a SINGLE creative consumes when generating (DCO-style — e.g. how many items fill one carousel/feed creative). When a catalog asset contains more items than this limit, the creative agent selects the top items based on relevance or catalog ordering. When item_limit exceeds the format's max_items, the creative agent SHOULD use the lesser of the two. Ignored when the manifest contains no catalog assets. Distinct from `max_creatives`, which fans OUT across catalog items to produce one distinct creative per item.

source_set.creative_id: must equal the source CreativeRepresentationSet creative_id
source_set.revision_id: must equal the source CreativeRepresentationSet revision_id
source_set.revision_content_digest: must equal the verified digest of the complete source CreativeRepresentationSet
source_set.selected_representation_id: must identify exactly one member of the complete source representations array
source_set.strategy: must equal the capability-advertised strategy requested for this resolution

derived_output.source_revision_unchanged: selection, macro binding, translation, and transcoding MUST NOT change the source revision binding
derived_output.canonical_content: RFC 8785 JCS of the manifest projection after removing exactly top-level $schema, representation_selection, creative_id, revision_id, name, tags, status, weight, placement_refs, placement_ids, and inputs properties; every other field, including unknown delivery fields, is included
derived_output.shared_projection: apply the same exclusion list to the returned CreativeManifest and to its later CreativeAsset sync wrapper so library metadata never changes the digest
derived_output.selected_output_digest: must equal lowercase-hex SHA-256 of derived-output canonical content before receiving-seller normalization
derived_output.review_identity: the receiving seller tracks (selected_representation_id, selected_output_digest, execution_vast_version-or-null, execution_daast_version-or-null) separately from the source revision; changing any member is an updated execution that follows ordinary re-review without minting a buyer revision
derived_output.execution_version: each execution version MUST equal the verified representation destination and later immutable package snapshot; a package mismatch requires re-resolution and ordinary re-review rather than silent rebinding
derived_output.approval_boundary: the exact selected output MUST complete the receiving seller's ordinary validation and review before serving; approval of one candidate never approves another
derived_output.runtime_selection: selection is pinned at trafficking time and MUST NOT be changed per viewer or device; device and player fallback stays within the selected manifest or VAST document
derived_output.selection_stability: after sync_creatives accepts this lineage, later product, placement, VAST, macro, or seller-capability changes MUST NOT cause implicit re-resolution, lineage replacement, or buyer re-review; only an explicit buyer-submitted selected output may replace it
derived_output.seller_inability: if the seller can no longer serve the pinned execution, it MUST preserve this lineage and use ordinary seller/system creative-status and media-buy impairment surfaces rather than silently substituting another representation

verifier_constraints.adcp_semantic_identity: when dialect is adcp, dialect_semantic must equal universal_semantic
verifier_constraints.declaration_id_uniqueness: declaration_id must be unique within the containing asset
verifier_constraints.token_occurrence: location must identify the declared zero-based occurrence of token in location.field
verifier_constraints.asset_field: location.field must exist on and be permitted by the containing asset type
verifier_constraints.catalog_universal_profile: catalog semantics require seller resolve_value in a URL context with exactly one rfc3986 pass
verifier_constraints.omit_parameter_scope: omit_parameter requires the token to occupy the complete URL query-parameter value

verifier_constraints.macro_aware_uri: mask recognized token lexical forms with an RFC3986 unreserved sentinel, whether declared or on the undeclared 3.x compatibility path, then require a valid absolute HTTP or HTTPS URI; masking assigns no semantics

revision_identity.complete_preimage: the complete CreativeRepresentationSet, never only the selected representation
revision_identity.canonical_content: RFC 8785 JCS after removing exactly the top-level $schema, creative_id, revision_id, revision_content_digest, and name properties
revision_identity.digest: revision_content_digest MUST equal lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the canonical content
revision_identity.immutability: reusing creative_id plus revision_id with a different digest or canonical content MUST fail with CREATIVE_REVISION_CONTENT_MISMATCH
revision_identity.equivalence_assertion: the buyer asserts that all representations are equivalent; the digest proves set integrity, not semantic or rendered equivalence

verifier_constraints.seller_authority: the build_creative endpoint MUST be the sales agent that owns product_id
verifier_constraints.current_product_match: format_option MUST exactly match one effective current format option for product_id after every applicable placement and publisher narrowing
verifier_constraints.placement_scope: when placement_refs is omitted, the representation must satisfy the common effective contract for every placement where the product may deliver
verifier_constraints.execution_intersection: resolution additionally intersects the seller's current media_buy.execution.creative_specs VAST and macro ceilings; the request does not override those capabilities
verifier_constraints.tracker_execution_version: when a candidate contains first-class vast_tracker or daast_tracker assets and no sibling VAST/DAAST delivery document supplies one exact version, the matching execution_*_version is required, MUST belong to the destination acceptance set, and MUST be preserved in representation_selection; the seller MUST NOT guess or defer it to a later package

verifier_constraints.translation_chain_closure: every translate_to_native entry must have an exact matching resolve_value entry for its translation_target in this same array

x-adcp-validation.version_sets: For one non-version selector identity, version sets must be identical or disjoint; overlapping unequal sets are invalid.
x-adcp-validation.asset_normalization: Before selector matching, omitted pixel_tracker.method becomes img, omitted VAST/DAAST target becomes linear, and offset on a non-progress asset is ignored and removed. Existing 3.x asset schemas remain structurally permissive; the selector schema supplies the closed event/target matrix for contract matching.
x-adcp-validation.format_slot_satisfiability: Every asset_type named by honored MUST have at least one matching first-class slot in the effective selected canonical format declaration. A contract cannot promise execution for an asset shape that the same format rejects structurally.
x-adcp-validation.layer_derivation: Publisher, placement, and seller effective-contract derivation is evaluated over atomic tuples of normalized non-version selector identity, one exact version (or null for pixel), execution_actor, and one firing_path. For a complete parent, every child tuple MUST exist in the parent, the child remains complete, and array compression MUST NOT create a version/path cross-product. An incomplete or omitted parent is not a ceiling: a child may add or omit affirmative tuples for its narrower scope, but remains incomplete until every applicable layer is complete. Omission from an incomplete child is undeclared, not an assertion that the tuple is unsupported.
x-adcp-validation.cardinality: Each accepted manifest tracker instance is initiated exactly once in total for each logical event occurrence; identical URLs are not deduplicated.

verifier_constraints.adcp_semantic_identity: when dialect is adcp, dialect_semantic must equal universal_semantic
verifier_constraints.translation_chain: a translate_to_native entry is usable only when the same capability set contains an exact resolve_value entry for translation_target

verifier_constraints.ctv_experience_matrix: ctv_ad_experience on image must be pause or screensaver
verifier_constraints.motion_level_static_canonical: motion_level full_motion is rejected on image
verifier_constraints.ctv_activation_copy_slots: push_notification activation_methods SHOULD declare an activation_message slot; text_message SHOULD declare an activation_text_message slot; email SHOULD declare activation_email_subject and activation_email_body slots. Missing copy slots emit a non-blocking validate_input warnings[] entry.

external:formats/canonical/_base.json.x-canonical-policy-required-params-not-e: Canonical format schemas intentionally do NOT mark parameter fields as required and use additionalProperties: true. The canonical describes which parameters MAY narrow a declaration; it does not supply hidden technical defaults. When a technical parameter is omitted, its meaning comes only from the enclosing declaration's technical_requirements_complete assertion: true means no constraint at that layer, while false or absence means undeclared. Consumers MUST NOT infer an omitted technical constraint from canonical prose, examples, common practice, or implementation defaults. This is intentional: structural schema validation and product-level technical-contract completeness are separate checks.
external:formats/canonical/_base.json.x-adcp-file-size-units: Creative file-size fields ending in `_kb` use exactly 1,000 bytes per KB. Fields ending in `_mb` use exactly 1,000,000 bytes per MB. Fields ending in `_bytes` are exact byte counts.

verifier_constraints.ctv_experience_matrix: ctv_ad_experience on video_hosted must be screensaver
ctv_ad_experience on video_vast must be one of pause, screensaver, overlay, squeezeback, in_scene, with creative_type nonlinear
verifier_constraints.ctv_nonlinear_no_simid: Every video_vast CTV experience is nonlinear and forbids simid_supported true because VAST serializes InteractiveCreativeFile only under Linear MediaFiles
verifier_constraints.ctv_duration_floors: overlay and squeezeback require duration_ms_exact or duration_ms_range minimum of at least 10000; in_scene at least 3000; pause has no floor
verifier_constraints.ctv_activation_copy_slots: push_notification activation_methods SHOULD declare an activation_message slot; text_message SHOULD declare an activation_text_message slot; email SHOULD declare activation_email_subject and activation_email_body slots. Missing copy slots emit a non-blocking validate_input warnings[] entry.
verifier_constraints.creative_type_precedence: creative_type wins over linear_required when both are declared; linear_required true with creative_type nonlinear or either is a contradiction and is rejected

verifier_constraints.range_order: When both bounds are declared, min_width MUST be <= max_width, min_height MUST be <= max_height, and min_bitrate_kbps MUST be <= max_bitrate_kbps.
verifier_constraints.adaptive_bitrate_containment: A MediaFile advertising a minBitrate/maxBitrate interval satisfies declared bitrate bounds only when its entire interval is contained within those bounds; overlap alone is insufficient.
verifier_constraints.alternative_renditions: For each applicable resolved InLine linear creative, at least one MediaFile MUST satisfy every declared property in this object; requirements MUST NOT be satisfied by combining properties from different MediaFile elements.
verifier_constraints.missing_metadata: If a declared property cannot be established from VAST metadata or safe inspection, compatibility is unproven and the MediaFile does not satisfy that property.

verifier_constraints.ctv_experience_matrix: ctv_ad_experience on sponsored_placement must be menu, squeezeback, or in_scene
ctv_ad_experience on native_in_feed must be menu or overlay
verifier_constraints.menu_profile_fields: menu_placement and focus_behavior require ctv_ad_experience menu
verifier_constraints.focus_video_pairing: focus_behavior autoplay_muted or autoplay_sound requires the effective slots to include the video asset group
verifier_constraints.ctv_activation_copy_slots: push_notification activation_methods SHOULD declare an activation_message slot; text_message SHOULD declare an activation_text_message slot; email SHOULD declare activation_email_subject and activation_email_body slots. Missing copy slots emit a non-blocking validate_input warnings[] entry.

verifier_constraints.initial_state_resolution: initial_state_id must resolve to a declared state
verifier_constraints.single_state_shape: when states has one entry, transitions must be absent or empty and initial_state_id must equal the sole state; when states has more than one entry, transitions must be present and non-empty
verifier_constraints.transition_exit_determinism: at most one transition out of a given state per cause tuple (trigger, plus input for user_action, media_event for media_event, direction for scroll_threshold); distinct causes may coexist and the seller runtime arms whichever inputs the device supports
verifier_constraints.transition_state_resolution: transition endpoints must resolve to distinct declared states
verifier_constraints.scroll_progress_bounds: scroll_start_percent must be less than scroll_end_percent
verifier_constraints.scroll_linked_binding: transition_mode scroll_linked is valid only with trigger scroll_progress
verifier_constraints.state_reachability: every non-initial state must be reachable from initial_state_id
verifier_constraints.timer_cycle_floor: timer and in_view_timer transitions participating in a state cycle must declare delay_ms >= 1000
verifier_constraints.dismissibility_floor: any state anchored overlay or fullscreen_overlay requires user_controls.dismissible true or that state's close_affordance true
verifier_constraints.breakpoint_id_uniqueness: breakpoints[].breakpoint_id values must be unique within each state
verifier_constraints.width_range_order: width_range minimum must be less than or equal to maximum
verifier_constraints.height_range_order: height_range minimum must be less than or equal to maximum
verifier_constraints.aspect_consistency: canvas_aspect_ratio must be consistent with fixed width and height when both are declared
verifier_constraints.duration_ms_range_order: duration_ms_range[0] must be less than or equal to duration_ms_range[1] when both are non-null
verifier_constraints.motion_animation_bound: max_animation_s is required when a state's motion is animated and forbidden when static
verifier_constraints.slot_binding_resolution: states[].slot_bindings values must resolve to declared slot asset_group_ids
verifier_constraints.allowed_slot_asset_types: declaration slots (including params.slots overrides) must not widen the canonical's allowed asset types; executable types are rejected
verifier_constraints.supply_mode_manifest: components mode forbids state_canvases and layered_source assets; rendered_canvases mode requires full canvas coverage and forbids layered_source; layered_source mode requires a layered_source asset and forbids state_canvases
verifier_constraints.fluid_breakpoint_supply: breakpoints using width_mode or viewport_height_percent cannot be targeted by rendered_canvases supply
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_coverage: in rendered_canvases mode, exactly one state_canvases image per declared state and breakpoint pair
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_dimensions: canvas width must equal declared width or fall within width_range; height must equal fixed height or fall within height_range
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_extras: undeclared and duplicate state/breakpoint pairs are rejected
verifier_constraints.clickthrough_policy: landing_page_url required when clickthrough is required; landing_page_url and state_click_urls forbidden when clickthrough is none
verifier_constraints.state_click_url_resolution: state_click_urls entries must carry state_id resolving to a declared state, with at most one entry per state
verifier_constraints.lean_policy_warnings: non-user-action transitions into overlay/fullscreen_overlay anchoring, hover-triggered expansion, and scroll transitions into overlay anchoring emit policy warnings (non-blocking)

verifier_constraints.selector_resolution: state_id and breakpoint_id resolve against the containing seller_rendered_stateful_display declaration; coordinated_placements component constraints omit both selectors
verifier_constraints.region_bounds: percent regions satisfy x + width <= 100 and y + height <= 100; pixel regions fit within every selected canvas

verifier_constraints.required_component: at least one component must be required
verifier_constraints.placement_ref_resolution: components[].placement_ref values must resolve to distinct Product.placements[] entries
verifier_constraints.format_option_ref_resolution: component references resolve only against sibling format_options entries on the same product
verifier_constraints.component_kind: resolved and inline components cannot be custom or coordinated_placements
verifier_constraints.inline_params: inline params validate against the schema selected by inline format_kind
verifier_constraints.component_assets: required components have a component_assets entry satisfying their resolved canonical slots
verifier_constraints.sequence_values: when any component declares sequence, sequence values must start at 1 and be contiguous across the declared set
verifier_constraints.referenced_option_schema: declarations resolved via format_option_ref are schema-validated identically to inline params
verifier_constraints.shared_slot_consumers: every shared_slots[].consumed_by value resolves to a declared component_id whose canonical slots accept the shared asset_group_id and asset_type

description: Request to transform, generate, resolve, refine, or retrieve a creative manifest. Supports five modes: (1) generation from a brief or seed assets, (2) transformation of an existing manifest, (3) deterministic seller-bound selection from a pre-binding CreativeRepresentationSet, (4) refinement of a prior produced variant via refine_from_build_variant_id, and (5) retrieval from a creative library by creative_id. Produces target manifest(s) through canonical capabilities advertised in `get_adcp_capabilities.creative.supported_formats[]`. CreativeRepresentationSet input is a non-generative, single-output mode available only on the destination sales agent and additionally requires `creative.representation_resolution.supported: true`. In 3.2, provide `target_capability_id` for one output or `target_capability_ids` for multiple outputs. Legacy named-format selectors remain accepted during the 3.x compatibility window but are deprecated.
